entities.summary: Aleksandr Fedoseyevich Zasukhin was a Soviet boxer who won two silver medals at the European championships of 1953 and 1955. He competed at the 1952 Olympics, but was eliminated in the second bout. During his career Zasukhin won four national titles and 165 bouts out of 185.
